_how_to_add: Copy one {...} block, paste it after the last one with a comma between blocks, then change the values. Required: name, link. Optional: category (groups products and makes filter buttons), tag (small badge such as Affiliate, Sponsored, Community, Free), cta (button text, default View), price, oldPrice, description, note, image. Without an image a coloured letter is shown.
